# MarginSignal OS

> The independent referee for whether deployed AI actually worked. MarginSignal OS independently verifies whether AI lowered the true Cost Per Resolution and attributes fault across data, model-vendor, operator, and agent — neutral, reproducible evidence for government, insurance, healthcare, and BPO, because it isn't yours.

MarginSignal OS is operator-independent: it is not run by, or paid by, the operator whose AI it grades. Core methods are patent-pending. Outputs are labeled and conditional until validated against client data.

## Core
- [MarginSignal OS | Independent Verification That Your AI Actually Works](https://www.marginsignalos.com/): Independent verification of whether your deployed AI lowered the true cost of a resolution — and who's at fault when it didn't. Because it isn't yours.
- [The Moat: The Builder Can't Certify the AI Worked](https://www.marginsignalos.com/independence): Every other AI-assurance vendor is paid by the operator it grades. We're structurally not: buyer-pays, reproducible, EU AI Act Art. 31.
- [Independence Charter (v1.0)](https://www.marginsignalos.com/independence-charter): The formal, signable independence policy of MarginSignal OS LLC — buyer-pays, no entanglement with rated parties, reproducible, disclosed. The data-room version of /independence.
- [How We Measure AI Outcomes — Methodology](https://www.marginsignalos.com/methodology): How MarginSignal OS measures whether deployed AI actually worked — eight operating signals across resolution economics, escalation, repeat demand, and margin.
- [Did Your AI Actually Work? Here's How You'd Know](https://www.marginsignalos.com/verify): Most vendors show you a dashboard. We show you a verdict — then let you re-run it. See a sample verdict and estimate your own true Cost Per Resolution.

## Industries
- [Independent AI Resolution-Cost Verification for Insurance Claims](https://www.marginsignalos.com/insurance-claims): As AI moves into claims, MarginSignal OS independently verifies whether it lowered the true Cost Per Resolution — or just closed files faster. P&C and health.
- [Independent AI Resolution-Cost Verification for Healthcare RCM](https://www.marginsignalos.com/healthcare-rcm): As AI moves into authorizations and billing, MarginSignal OS independently verifies whether it lowered the cost of a resolved case — not just denial rates.
- [Independent AI Resolution-Cost Verification for BPO & MSP](https://www.marginsignalos.com/bpo-msp): SLA-compliant delivery can bleed margin. As AI handles more of the queue, MarginSignal OS independently verifies whether it lowered your true cost-to-resolve.

## Decision-makers
- [Independent Post-Deployment AI Impact for Federal](https://www.marginsignalos.com/for-federal): OMB M-25-21 requires independent post-deployment AI review. We give agencies an outside read on whether veteran-facing AI works — in weeks, de-identified.
- [The Moat Isn't the Model — It's Who's Allowed to Grade It](https://www.marginsignalos.com/for-investors): Every funded AI-assurance incumbent is paid by the operator it grades. MarginSignal OS structurally can't be. The moat, the category, and a dated catalyst.

## Tools & engagement
- [Is Your AI Actually Lowering the Cost of a Resolution?](https://www.marginsignalos.com/exposure-review): Answer 9 questions for an independent estimate of your true Cost Per Resolution — and whether your AI is lowering it, or just closing tickets faster.
- [The CPR Gap Calculator — What Your AI Actually Costs Per Resolution](https://www.marginsignalos.com/cpr-gap): Your dashboard shows cost per contact. The real number is Cost Per Resolution — and the gap between them is where your margin leaks. Estimate yours in 30 seconds, no signup.
- [Become a Design Partner — Be the First Reproducible AI Verdict](https://www.marginsignalos.com/design-partner): Help produce the first public, reproducible verdicts on whether deployed AI actually worked. Defined terms in your favor, 30–60 days. Commercial & federal.
- [Capability Statement](https://www.marginsignalos.com/capabilities): MarginSignal OS LLC capability statement for procurement — independent verification (IV&V / TEVV) and cross-party fault attribution for AI-enabled and autonomous systems. UEI, CAGE, NAICS, PSC.
